svg.title: AtliQ Commerce — End-to-End Batch Data Platform
svg.text: AtliQ Commerce — End-to-End Batch Data Platform
Nightly incremental sync from the OLTP database and flat files to a Power BI dashboard
Retry and run-start time handled per run
What to load, how, and from where
ADLS Gen2 storage · Unity Catalog · Delta Lake
Schedule trigger runs daily at 01:00 AM Eastern. Order of work: OLTP and CSV ingest to Bronze, then both Silver notebooks, then a web call that starts the dbt GitHub Action for Gold.
Pull request runs dbt build and tests against a CI validation location. After merge, the prod target writes the Gold layer. Pipelines are incremental and safe to re-run.
Dashed arrows show what the nightly trigger starts
